declaration.goal: Find the setting of the four knobs with the lowest cd among the settings where shedding is 0.

knobs.description: The length of the body, in body heights. The height of the body is 1, so this is the length divided by the height.
knobs.name: aspect

knobs.description: The rounding of the body's corners: the radius of each corner arc, as a fraction of half of the body's shorter side. 0 gives square corners; 1 gives the largest radius that fits.
knobs.name: corner

knobs.description: The length of the thin plate attached to the back of the body, the end facing away from the oncoming flow, in body heights. The length is counted from the rearmost point of the body without the plate. The plate lies along the line through the middle of the body along its length, is attached with no gap, and is 0.08 body heights thick. 0 means there is no plate.
knobs.name: splitter

knobs.description: The angle of attack, in degrees: the angle between the body's length direction and the direction of the oncoming flow, which goes in the +x direction. 0 means the two directions are the same. The body is turned about its centre, the middle of its length and of its height, and the plate turns with it. A positive angle moves the front end of the body, the end facing the oncoming flow, toward +y, and the back end toward -y.
knobs.name: angle

declaration.measured_by: The oncoming flow goes in the +x direction, and the lift is the force along +y. Forces are per unit depth and are divided by one half of the density times the square of the free-stream speed times the height; the height is a fixed length that no knob changes; lengths are in units of the height and speeds in units of the free-stream speed. cd is the drag coefficient: the force along the flow on the whole body, taken as the mean over the settled part of the trial. cl_mean is the mean of the lift coefficient over the settled part. cl_amp is half of the difference between the largest and the smallest lift coefficient over the settled part (half the peak-to-peak value). strouhal is the frequency of the lift coefficient's oscillation, times the height, divided by the free-stream speed. shedding is 1 when cl_amp is above 0.01 and 0 otherwise. When the flow has not settled within the trial, none of the five is measured: each is the not-measured outcome not_settled, and the picture is still returned. This says nothing about whether a longer trial would settle.

statement.text: WHEN aspect is 1, corner is 0, splitter is 0 and angle is 0, THE system SHALL show vortex shedding with cd between 1.4 and 2.8.

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Baseline square (aspect 1, corner 0, splitter 0, angle 0): cd 1.55, shedding 1, cl_amp 0.43, St 0.160. Both predictions hit. Corner 1: cd 1.41, cl_amp 0.56, St 0.188. Splitter 2: cd 1.39, cl_amp 0.63, St 0.155. All three trials shed; neither rounding nor a 2-height plate stops shedding alone, but both lower cd. Pictures show alternating vortex street in all, plate extends into the wake.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN aspect rises from 0.5 to 3 with corner 0, splitter 0 and angle 0, THE system SHALL show falling cd, with cd at aspect 3 between 0.6 and 1.4 and cd at aspect 0.5 above 1.5.

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Aspect 0.5: cd 2.17, cl_amp 0.93, St 0.187. Aspect 2: cd 1.34, cl_amp 0.21, St 0.158. Aspect 3: cd 1.29, cl_amp 0.22, St 0.152. Both predictions hit. cd falls with aspect, flattening past 2. cl_amp falls strongly from aspect 0.5 to 2 then stays near 0.2, so still shedding at aspect 3. Picture of aspect 3 shows a weaker but clear street.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN aspect is 3 and corner is 1, THE system SHALL have lower cd and lower cl_amp than the aspect 3 square-cornered body (cd 1.29, cl_amp 0.22), and with a splitter of 3 THE system SHALL stop shedding.

Angle 8 on aspect 3 square: cd 2.01, cl_mean 1.64, cl_amp 0.98, St 0.148, so angle raises drag, lift and unsteadiness strongly. All three predictions hit.
